sum: A three-day walk from Sundarijal through Shivapuri forest to Chisapani, along the valley rim to Nagarkot, and down to the temple village of Changu Narayan.

guide.note: The Nepal Tourism Board has required foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide since April 2023, and checks are inconsistent; on a low route like this one the rule is rarely applied on the trail. The place it matters is the Sundarijal gate, where park staff have at times refused entry to foreigners walking alone. A guide also saves time on the second day, which follows a web of unsigned dirt roads and village paths.

access: Both ends are inside the Kathmandu Valley. Sundarijal is under an hour by taxi from Thamel, or a little longer by local bus. From Changu Narayan, buses and taxis run to Bhaktapur and on to Kathmandu in about an hour and a half. Nagarkot and Dhulikhel also have buses if you finish there.

photo.a: Farmhouses and terraced fields with yellow mustard cover a hillside near Nagarkot, with a line of snow peaks above the haze on the horizon.
photo.c: Village terraces and the Himalaya from Nagarkot

includes: transport to Sundarijal and back from Nagarkot
meals vary (some packages leave out lunch and dinner)

permits.name: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park entry ticket
permits.fee: NPR 1,000 per person, per day and entry
permits.where: At the park gate, for example at Sundarijal.

transportText: A taxi shared by two, or the local bus, from Kathmandu to Sundarijal
transportExtra: the bus or taxi back from Changu Narayan
tips: Leave Thamel by 8 am on the first day, so that you reach Chisapani with daylight to spare for the sunset.
Carry lunch or snacks on the second day. Tea shops are spread out and may be shut on quiet weekdays.
Book Nagarkot ahead for Friday and Saturday nights, when families from Kathmandu fill the hotels.
Keep the national park ticket until you are out of the forest beyond Chisapani; it may be checked at the far boundary too.
Bring a head torch for the two dawn viewpoints, and small notes for tea shops and buses.

days.t: Drive to Sundarijal, walk to Chisapani
days.note: A taxi or bus to the park gate, then close to 1,000 m of ascent: stone steps past the reservoir, terraces around Mulkharka and a long pull through oak and rhododendron forest to the Borlang Bhanjyang saddle. From there it is downhill to the hotels at Chisapani, in time for sunset.

n: Hotel Trekkers paradise and Mountain View Restaurant

days.note: The long day. A forest track leaves the national park near Jhule, then dirt roads and village paths follow the ridge to Jarsingpauwa, dip to Kattike and climb through pines to Nagarkot. Published distances range from 15 to 26 km; plan on seven to eight hours of walking whichever line you take.

days.t: Nagarkot to Changu Narayan, drive to Kathmandu
days.note: Up early for the sunrise, then an easy walk west down the ridge through Telkot and pine forest to the temple at Changu Narayan. Give the courtyard an hour before taking a bus or taxi to Bhaktapur and on to Kathmandu.
